hook: AI didn't just write code—it just discovered new biology.
spoken_script: AI didn't just write code—it just discovered new biology. Anthropic deployed about one thousand Claude agents to scan nearly two billion protein clusters. In just about twenty-one hours, Claude discovered ART: a novel enzyme system hidden inside viruses with repeating arrays that resemble CRISPR. Human scientists verified it in their San Francisco wet lab, confirming the array produces short RNA molecules. This is not a gene therapy or a human gene-editing tool. It's a new biological architecture. If you found this useful, like, share, and subscribe.
